fieldGlossary.margins: Minutes added to the computed instant per row, after rounding policy is applied as the source applies it. Polymorphic: a flat object of six rows, or a banded object with switch/sets when the authority switches margins by latitude.
fieldGlossary.rounding: Per-row direction applied to the computed instant: nearest | up | down | none. Provenance per group, with perField overrides.
fieldGlossary.fajrRule.kind: angle | fixed | monthlyOverride | seasonalSweep | intervalTable | interval | notPublished | clockSchedule
fieldGlossary.ishaRule.kind: angle | interval | ramadanInterval | twilightRatio | notPublished | intervalTable
fieldGlossary.notPublished: The authority prints no such row at all; the app must render nothing rather than substitute.
fieldGlossary.highLatitude.kind: one of the eleven kinds enumerated in highLatitudeKinds below
fieldGlossary.derivedTimes: Rows the authority prints that are not one of the six astronomical prayers: imsak, syuruk, duha, iftar, suhoor, haraj, qiyam.
fieldGlossary.clock.dstMode: iana (follow the civil zone) | fixed (print permanently on fixedOffsetMinutes, ignoring civil DST)
fieldGlossary.evidence.fullYear: true only where the record measures a whole year; otherwise the measured day count stands and the gap says so.
fieldGlossary.roundingFormulation: How the margin and the rounding compose, stated once per object where the pair is degenerate: marginThenFloor | marginThenCeil | null. A builder that applies both a +1 margin and ceil lands a minute late (T-667 #6934 scores that form at 23.9 pc).
fieldGlossary.singleFormulationRule: An object-level exclusivity block: floor(raw + margin) OR ceil(raw), never both, with the rejected form's score.
fieldGlossary.intervalTable: A date-keyed integer table (MM-DD, 366 entries) that replaces the angle outright: no formula reproduces it and it is identical in every year. GB-LONDON-INTERVAL-TABLE is the only user.
fieldGlossary.maghribRule: A maghrib row the authority prints as an angle rather than a sunset offset. IR-NATIONAL is the only user (4.47 deg depression); without this field a consumer computes maghrib at the horizon and runs minutes early.
fieldGlossary.rollover: What a post-midnight clock reading belongs to: the prayer's own astronomical date, not the civil date printed.
fieldGlossary.displayCorrections: A published correction by height or storey band, applied at display time rather than in the instant (Sri Lanka only).
fieldGlossary.feedExceptions: Months where a feed departs from its own recipe. Carried as annual overrides, never as recipe failures (Hong Kong only).
fieldGlossary.recipeVariants: Two equally clean parameterisations of one authority. The choice is presentation, not measurement (Iraq only).
fieldGlossary.tier: authority | community. Who publishes, never how good the fit is.
fieldGlossary.evidence.grade: A | provisional | community | candidate | F, per gradingScale and the owner ruling T-667 #6943.
fieldGlossary.evidence.fitYears: Distinct years of fitted evidence. Zero where the surface is a candidate or a scheme with no series.
